decisions.reason: On the unit cube, time-constant E=e_x,H=e_y,J=0 have zero bulk curls and zero total outward flux, so the former scalar energy-pair identity accepts E_tau=H_tau=0 for every Y>0. These data fail to represent the bulk traces and misidentify local boundary power. The repair requires separately, for u=E,H and every smooth compactly supported ambient vector test phi, integral_Omega(curl u dot phi-u dot curl phi)=integral_Gamma(n cross u_tau) dot phi. For E=e_x take phi=(0,0,y) near the closed cube with compactly supported smooth continuation: the bulk side is -1 and zero boundary data give 0. This excludes the counterexample without altering the bulk or PEC classes, energy definition or nonnegative-admittance law. The scalar energy-pair Green identity remains an explicit additional hypothesis, not an unproved rough-test extension.

reviews.reason: Checked the current complete Definition, direct supplier statements, owning contract and page, and all six direct item consumers. Added the weak tangential trace identity separately for both bulk fields against all smooth ambient tests outside one common null set of times. Its n cross u_tau sign agrees with Chen Section 3.2 equation (8), which uses u cross n on the opposite side. All integrals are finite: bulk fields and curls are L2, smooth tests are bounded on the bounded closure, and boundary traces are L2 on finite face area. Tangency, the separate energy-pair identity, global boundary-time L2 requirement, bounded static Y>=0, positive coefficients, AC_omega, Gauss exclusions and no-existence/no-empirical claims are retained. Zero fields obey every test condition. No general H(curl)-to-L2 trace theorem or extension to rough test fields is invoked. The public physical_scope and owning manifest mirrors were updated under the shared write lock. No diagrams occur in the assigned item. This is the author-adjudicator review of the repair, not independent acceptance.
